## Recommended brand universe

For a hotel project in Mexico, the owner should initially consider **10–15 brands**, then narrow the field based on location, buyer profile, unit pricing, density, and operating model. Mexico is already a well-established branded-residence market—particularly in Los Cabos, Riviera Nayarit, Riviera Maya and, increasingly, Mexico City. Marriott and Accor have the largest global multi-brand platforms, while Four Seasons remains one of the strongest individual residential brands. ([brandedresi.com](https://brandedresi.com/savills-branded-residences-report-25-26-key-takeaways/?utm_source=openai))

### 1. Ultra-luxury resort brands

Best for low-density beachfront, golf, marina or nature-oriented developments targeting high-net-worth North American and Mexican buyers.

- **Four Seasons**
- **Rosewood**
- **Aman**
- **One&Only**
- **Ritz-Carlton Reserve**
- **Auberge Resorts Collection**
- **Montage**
- **Mandarin Oriental**

These brands generally offer the greatest potential sales premium, but also impose the highest standards for site quality, architecture, amenities, hotel capitalization and service delivery.

They have strong precedent in Mexico: Four Seasons operates residential projects in Los Cabos and Punta Mita; Rosewood has residences at Mayakoba and Mandarina; One&Only has Private Homes at Mandarina; Aman has introduced Amanvari residences on the East Cape; and Ritz-Carlton Reserve has residential products at Zadún and Siari. ([fourseasons.com](https://www.fourseasons.com/regional-collections/mexico-travel/?utm_source=openai))

**Best applications:** Los Cabos/East Cape, Punta Mita, Riviera Nayarit, Riviera Maya and highly differentiated emerging coastal destinations.

---

### 2. Established global luxury brands

Best when the owner wants strong international recognition, loyalty-program distribution and a somewhat broader buyer pool than the ultra-luxury independents.

- **The Ritz-Carlton**
- **St. Regis**
- **Waldorf Astoria**
- **Park Hyatt**
- **Fairmont**
- **Conrad**
- **JW Marriott**
- **The Luxury Collection**
- **LXR Hotels & Resorts**
- **Regent**

Marriott merits particular attention because it has a mature residential platform covering 16 brands, from Ritz-Carlton Reserve and St. Regis through JW Marriott, W, Luxury Collection, Westin and Autograph Collection. ([marriottresidences.com](https://marriottresidences.com/brands/?utm_source=openai))

Hilton’s relevant residential brands include Waldorf Astoria, Conrad, LXR and selected Curio Collection properties. Its current Mexican residential references include Waldorf Astoria Los Cabos Pedregal, Waldorf Astoria San Miguel de Allende and The Fives Downtown under Curio Collection. ([stories.hilton.com](https://stories.hilton.com/branded-residential-by-hilton-fact-sheet?utm_source=openai))

**Best applications:** luxury resorts, golf communities, urban mixed-use towers and projects requiring broad international sales recognition.

---

### 3. Luxury lifestyle brands

Best for younger buyers, design-conscious consumers, food-and-beverage-driven projects and destinations where social programming is a major selling point.

- **EDITION**
- **W Hotels**
- **Thompson Hotels**
- **The Standard**
- **SLS**
- **Delano**
- **Nobu**
- **Kimpton**
- **Andaz**
- **Mondrian**
- **SO/**

Hyatt is particularly active in this category. Its residential platform includes Park Hyatt, Thompson, Andaz and The Standard, with announced Mexican residential activity in Los Cabos, Mexico City, Cancún and Puerto Vallarta. ([newsroom.hyatt.com](https://newsroom.hyatt.com/may-30-2025-unscriptedbyhyatt?utm_source=openai))

Ennismore/Accor offers SLS, Delano, Mondrian, Hyde and SO/. Delano East Cape has been announced with 60 branded residences, while SLS already has an operating presence in Playa Mujeres. ([group.accor.com](https://group.accor.com/en/brands-and-experiences/our-hotel-brands/sls-hotels?utm_source=openai))

Nobu has a proven Mexico reference with 60 residences adjoining Nobu Hotel Los Cabos and has identified a Tulum residential project in its pipeline. ([nobuhotels.com](https://www.nobuhotels.com/los-cabos/residences/?utm_source=openai))

**Best applications:** Mexico City, Monterrey, Guadalajara, Cancún, Puerto Vallarta, Cabo San Lucas and mixed-use entertainment districts.

---

### 4. Wellness and nature-led brands

Best for environmentally sensitive sites, wellness communities and projects where privacy and destination immersion are more important than loyalty-program scale.

- **Six Senses**
- **Aman**
- **Alila**
- **Banyan Tree**
- **One&Only**
- **Rosewood**
- **Auberge**
- **1 Hotels**, where available

IHG’s most relevant brands are Six Senses, Regent and Kimpton. Six Senses Xala is establishing the brand in Mexico, while Kimpton Monterrey was signed with 60 private residences, demonstrating IHG’s willingness to pursue Mexican urban residential projects. ([ihgplc.com](https://www.ihgplc.com/en/news-and-media/news-releases/2024/kimpton-expands-presence-in-mexico-with-signing-of-hotel-and-branded-residences-in-monterrey?utm_source=openai))

**Best applications:** Costalegre, East Cape, Riviera Nayarit, Riviera Maya and other low-density destinations with strong natural attributes.

---

### 5. More flexible upscale-luxury alternatives

For a project where ultra-luxury standards would make the hotel or residence HOA uneconomic, consider:

- **Autograph Collection Residences**
- **The Unbound Collection by Hyatt**
- **Curio Collection by Hilton**
- **Tribute Portfolio**
- **Westin Residences**
- **Marriott Residences**
- **InterContinental Residences**
- **Vignette Collection**

These brands can provide international distribution and brand recognition while allowing more individuality and potentially lower construction and operating costs. They are often better suited to larger residential programs or markets where unit pricing cannot support Four Seasons-, Aman- or Rosewood-level services.

## Suggested shortlist by project type

| Project type | Brands I would prioritize |
|---|---|
| **Trophy Los Cabos/East Cape resort** | Four Seasons, Aman, Ritz-Carlton Reserve, Rosewood, One&Only, Auberge |
| **Punta Mita/Riviera Nayarit luxury resort** | Four Seasons, Rosewood, One&Only, Ritz-Carlton Reserve, Auberge, St. Regis |
| **Riviera Maya/Cancún luxury resort** | Rosewood, Fairmont, St. Regis, Waldorf Astoria, Banyan Tree, SLS |
| **Mexico City luxury tower** | Four Seasons, Ritz-Carlton, St. Regis, Park Hyatt, Waldorf Astoria, EDITION |
| **Urban lifestyle project** | Thompson, The Standard, Kimpton, SLS, Delano, Nobu, W |
| **Wellness/nature destination** | Six Senses, Aman, Alila, Rosewood, One&Only, Auberge |
| **Broader upscale buyer market** | JW Marriott, Conrad, Autograph Collection, Curio Collection, Unbound Collection |

## How the owner should evaluate the brands

The “best” brand is not necessarily the one promising the highest residential price. Each proposal should be tested against:

1. **Likely sales velocity and achievable price premium**, not just asking prices at competing projects.
2. **Brand and residential license fees**, technical-services fees, marketing charges and ongoing management fees.
3. **Required hotel size and hotel profitability** independent of residential sales.
4. **Construction cost associated with brand standards.**
5. **Annual residence service charges and HOA affordability.**
6. **Allocation of shared hotel-residential costs and amenities.**
7. **Rental-program structure and owner-use restrictions.**
8. **Brand control over residential sales materials and broker commissions.**
9. **Exclusivity radius and restrictions on future phases.**
10. **Termination, de-branding, lender cure and replacement-operator provisions.**
11. **The brand’s actual residential operating team**, rather than only its hotel development team.
12. **Experience with Mexican condominium governance, staffing and local ownership structures.**

## Practical recommendation

I would issue an initial request for proposals to **six to eight brands**, divided among:

- **Two or three ultra-luxury operators**
- **Two major global luxury platforms**
- **Two lifestyle brands**
- **One flexible collection or soft brand**

For a typical luxury Mexican resort, a strong first-round list would be:

**Four Seasons, Rosewood, Ritz-Carlton or Ritz-Carlton Reserve, One&Only, Park Hyatt, Waldorf Astoria, Auberge and either SLS/Delano or Thompson.**

The final selection should follow a project-specific residential feasibility study comparing net residential proceeds, hotel economics, capital requirements and owner obligations under each brand proposal—not simply the projected branding premium.
